metadata.title: Agent Skills Feedback Loop - Sources
metadata.description: Graded May-2026 evidence base for the learnings-loop maturity claims and the Layer 1 (auto-capture) and Layer 3 (eval-gated promotion) designs. Analytical grading and design mapping in references/evidence-base.md.

research_peer_reviewed.name: Memory for Autonomous LLM Agents: Mechanisms, Evaluation, and Emerging Frontiers (arXiv 2603.07670)
research_peer_reviewed.description: Grade A. Survey establishing memory as a first-class agent discipline in 2026; names the open problems (continual consolidation, trustworthy reflection, learned forgetting) that justify keeping Layers 2-3 conservative.

research_peer_reviewed.name: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models (arXiv 2510.04618, ICLR 2026)
research_peer_reviewed.description: Grade A. SOTA shape for Layer 2 consolidation: Generator/Reflector/Curator evolving playbook; defines the 'context collapse' and 'brevity bias' failure modes structured incremental consolidation must avoid.

research_peer_reviewed.name: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Memory for LLM-Based Agentic Systems (MemAgents)
research_peer_reviewed.description: Grade A. Evidence that memory-for-agents is an active first-class research venue in 2026 - the field is unsettled, which is why this skill keeps promotion human-gated.

research_peer_reviewed.name: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills (arXiv 2605.23904)
research_peer_reviewed.description: Grade A (May 2026). First systematic text-space optimizer for agent skills: optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits accepted only when they strictly improve held-out validation score. +23.5pp on GPT-5.5, tested across Claude Code and Codex. Confirms the Layer 3 gate principle: quality of the verifier bounds quality of self-improvement.

research_peer_reviewed.name: CoEvoSkills: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Co-Evolutionary Verification (arXiv 2604.01687)
research_peer_reviewed.description: Grade A (April 2026; retitled from 'EvoSkills' between v1 and v2, confirmed July 2026). Co-evolutionary verification framework (Skill Generator + Surrogate Verifier, no ground-truth) achieving 71.1% pass rate on SkillsBench (+40.5pp over no-skill). Both SkillOpt and CoEvoSkills use held-out/surrogate validation gates, validating this skill's human-gated promotion model as the conservative zero-cost form of the same pattern.

industry_practice.name: Testing Agent Skills Systematically with Evals - OpenAI
industry_practice.description: Grade B. Establishes eval mechanics this design reuses (captured run -> checks -> comparable score; failures become tests). Re-verified July 2026: covers measurement, not threshold gating or CI blocking -- that half is sourced from Braintrust below, not this page.

industry_practice.name: Agent Observability: The Complete Guide for 2026 - Braintrust
industry_practice.description: Grade C. Production-failure -> eval -> CI-gate workflow; corroborates the Layer 3 pattern from the tooling side. Vendor framing discounted.

industry_practice.name: State of AI Agent Memory 2026 - mem0
industry_practice.description: Grade C. Append-only ADD memory production-ready (92.5 on LoCoMo); procedural memory (agent-driven self-capture/consolidation) named explicitly as early-stage tooling, not production practice - corroborates Layer 1 default-off. Vendor framing discounted.

pattern_origin_and_press.name: What Is the Learnings Loop - MindStudio
pattern_origin_and_press.description: Grade C. The base loop pattern this skill is explicitly borrowed from (see SKILL.md intro); pattern evidence only, not validation.

pattern_origin_and_press.name: ACE Prevents Context Collapse with Evolving Playbooks for Self-Improving AI Agents - VentureBeat
pattern_origin_and_press.description: Grade C. Independent trade-press corroboration of ACE (arXiv 2510.04618); framing only, the paper is the load-bearing source.

external_patterns.name: ECC (Everything Claude Code) - continuous-learning-v2
external_patterns.description: Pattern-evidence only, not validated by this repo. Source of the atomic confidence-scored 'instinct' concept documented in references/instinct-pattern.md as a complement to the base learnings loop. This repo does not adopt ECC's automatic project-to-global promotion or its unverified '100% reliable' hook-capture claim.
